purpose: Frozen ACT component-agreement dynamic-horizon development smoke.

h1_reference.description: Reuse the valid Fresh 37/40 ACT reference from the completed CDTA development panel; Fresh is not rerun here.
h1_reference.pairing: same task, init_state_id 10..19, and environment seed 2000..2009 as the reference panel

policy.query: policy.predict_action_chunk followed by native policy and environment postprocessors

tasks.task_name: pick up the butter and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate
put the bowl on the stove
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

method_semantics.fixed_h4: Query at physical steps 0,4,8,...; on other steps execute the newest available same-target action from the latest sparse query record.
method_semantics.fixed_h8: Query at physical steps 0,8,16,...; on other steps execute the newest available same-target action from the latest sparse query record.
method_semantics.adaptive_h8_cos09: Before querying at physical step t, inspect only prior sparse query records. Query if same-target candidates <2, nearest query age >=8, the latest two candidate gripper signs disagree, or their arm cosine <0.90. Otherwise skip and execute the newest available candidate. No temporal averaging.

gates.query_rate_reducer: Pooled across all development episodes: sum(policy queries) / sum(environment steps).
